messages:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT — High tail latency observed for hosted inference (redwood-infer-prod). Incident PAGER-2247 created. Primary: @arya. Pages sent to on-call. Summary: 95th pct token latency > 1200ms. Affected routes: /v1/generate (region: us-west-2). Links: https://pager.redwood.internal/incidents/PAGER-2247

arya: Ack. I'm on it as primary. Quick triage: initial spikes correlate with kvcache eviction logs. Taking a look at metrics and infra.

mike: I'll take secondary. If you need me to flip primary, ping me and I can assume.

sana: FYI customers on the alerts page 3 tickets showing timeouts. Setting customer-impact = potential. will add links after I confirm.

arya: Notes so far:
- kv-cache thrashing on inference nodes infer-2/infer-3
- memory pressure followed by worker restarts
- fallback routing to smaller model (redwood/llama-7b) didn't fully engage

arya: Running quick mitigations from runbook: https://confluence.redwood.io/runbooks/serving/kvcache-thrash

runbook-bot: Recommended steps (from runbook):
1) Evict offending large prefixes from KV cache
2) Temporarily increase batch-window to 40ms
3) Route new requests to standby pool
4) If node unstable, cordon and restart
Commands:
```
# evict prefix
redwoodctl cache evict --prefix "user:session:*" --nodes infer-2,infer-3
# increase batching
redwoodctl config set --path /runtime/batching/window_ms 40
# cordon
kubectl cordon infer-2
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime -n inference
```

mike: Doing evict now. Ran `redwoodctl cache evict` — returned 342k keys evicted on infer-2.

sana: Confirming customer tickets: 3 customers reported >30s timeouts, all from us-west. Marking SRs with PAGER-2247.

jun: Quick suggestion — enable model-fallback-policy immediate for route /v1/generate while we heal nodes. Command:
```
redwoodctl routing update --route /v1/generate --fallback-model redwood/llama-7b --timeout-ms 500
```

arya: Applying fallback now. Also increasing cluster autoscaler min replicas for standby pool.

mike: After evict, CPU went down on infer-2. Memory drops followed, worker restart stabilized. 95th pct latency down to 420ms.

sana: Customer-impact -> limited (some requests timed out), alerted CS to reach out. Created ticket CS-3321 and linked to PAGER-2247.

arya: Handing over to @mike as primary for the remainder of shift. I'm off to sleep but left a short runbook checklist:
- monitor P95 and error-rate for /v1/generate
- keep fallback enabled for 30m
- if latency re-spikes: cordon node + rebuild image
- escalate to infra if more than 2 nodes failing

mike: Ack. I'll monitor for 60m and then do a brief handback. Saving runbook snippet: https://confluence.redwood.io/runbooks/serving/quick-fixes

incident-bot: PAGER-2247 updated: status -> mitigated (initial). Timeline and links: https://pager.redwood.internal/incidents/PAGER-2247/timeline

mike: final notes to handback: created follow-up ticket OP-889 (postmortem and capacity tuning), added action items for prewarming, kv-cache TTL review.

sana: marking handoff complete, primary -> mike, secondary -> jun. Good job team :thumbsup:

arya: thanks all. leaving clear notes in the ticket and the oncall doc. Good night.
